fact: The Institut National de la Santé report of March 2024 is the 8th report of national cause-of-death statistics, for 2021, compiled from 71,300 medical death certificates received against 100,454 deaths registered by the INS from civil registration, a coverage of 71.0 percent.
title: Le système national d'information sur les causes médicales des décès - Statistiques nationales sur les causes des décès en Tunisie 2021
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, Institut National de la Santé
